items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 5 at 3:38AM AKST until November 5 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Ketchikan Gateway Borough and Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 6 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough
items.instruction:
Report any damage to the National Weather Service by visiting
weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 3:38AM AKST until November 5 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 50 mph expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Juneau, City and Borough of Wrangell,
Petersburg Borough, and Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 6 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: City and Borough of Juneau; Petersburg Borough; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; City and Borough of Wrangell
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 5 at 3:38AM AKST until November 6 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
becoming Southwest.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka.

* WHEN...From 9 AM this morning to 9 AM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The gusty winds from the SE are expect
Thursday. There will then be a brief break before winds increase
again from the SW this time late Thursday night into Friday
morning.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 5 at 2:46AM AKST until November 6 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow. Total snow accumulations up to two
inches. Winds gusting between 35 and 45 mph.

* WHERE...Central Beaufort Sea Coast, Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast, and
Northern Arctic Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile. Localized blizzard
conditions will be possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strongest winds will be immediately along the
coast Thursday night into Friday af
items.areas: Northern Arctic Coast; Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.
